name: Mark's Keys
source:
'You're a fire in the dumpster of those born dead.'

Mark's Keys is a short, visceral visual novel following a rough morning for the irregular wolf named Mark; a stern security worker with a lot going on. Fight the currents to find your keys, get to work and pummel through your day, and try to ignore anything festering within.

[From [url=https://sunwsk.itch.io/markskeys]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你是死者垃圾箱里的一团火。”

《马克的钥匙》是一部简短、发自肺腑的视觉小说，讲述了一只名叫马克的不规则狼经历了一个艰难的早晨；一位严肃的保安人员，有很多事情要做。与潮流搏斗，找到你的钥匙，开始工作，度过你的一天，并尝试忽略内心溃烂的任何事情。

[来自[url=https://sunwsk.itch.io/markskeys]Itch.io[/url]]
